investigation_notes.Description: SharePoint reported an anomalous bulk download (alert summary 550 downloads; sampled evidence shows 250 files), which exceeds the user's 24-hour baseline of 30 files. The activity originated from Tokyo and the UTC timestamp converts to ~2026-02-01 08:20 local time, matching business hours and a recent confirmed planned holiday in Tokyo. The user's role (Principal Structural Architect) aligns with the accessed project folders and the access used a standard Chrome browser, so given the role alignment, local-business-hour timing, and prior location-alert closure as a false positive, this is assessed as Low Priority.
investigation_notes.Recent Similar Alert: SOC-12550 - User Login Location Anomaly on same endpoint; closed as False Positive after user confirmation of planned holiday in Tokyo until 2026-02-02
